original_evidence.text: | Stats | exelban/stats | Custom (not Sparkle) | Y | chk: auto, silent, on launch/periodic; dl/inst: manual — user must click the update notification to trigger download+install | Y (downloads a DMG, mounts it, and runs a bundled `updater.sh` shell script, elevating via `AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges` if the app dir isn't writable) | https (GitHub REST API `api.github.com`, and self-hosted `https://api.mac-stats.com`) | TLS-only (no cryptographic appcast/manifest signature — plain JSON over HTTPS) | OS-code-signing (`SecStaticCodeCheckValidity` + Team ID match between running app and mounted DMG before running the updater script — not a Sparkle-style detached signature) | none (no pinned EdDSA/DSA key; trust is TLS + Apple code-signing Team ID comparison at install time) | Kit/plugins/Updater.swift:64-67,169-320 (URLs, install/validateAppSignature/teamID); Stats/AppDelegate.swift:25,205-206; Stats/helpers.swift:147-184 |
